titleBack: The Time To Fight Is Now

flipToBack.prose: Flip if 4 Rebels are on table (anywhere), OR owner controls at least 2 battleground systems with a Rebel among the controlling presence. SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE on both legs.

children.req: count-spot on table: at least 4 Rebels anywhere on table
control-with: owner controls >=2 battleground systems with Rebel present

flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if FEWER than 4 Rebels are on table AND owner does NOT occupy at least 2 battlegrounds (any battleground: site or system). Four Rebels on table alone holds the back regardless of occupation.

children.req: count-spot: at least 4 Rebels on table
occupy-count: owner occupies >=2 battlegrounds (sites or systems)

requirementSemantics: flipToBack leg 1: on-table count semantics (canSpot 4 x Filters.Rebel), no location requirement whatsoever.
flipToBack leg 2: CONTROL-WITH semantics: owner controls >=2 battleground SYSTEMS with at least a Rebel there (cardFilter Filters.Rebel). Control, not occupy; systems, not sites.

flipToFront: conjunction of two negations: NOT (4 Rebels on table) AND NOT (owner OCCUPIES 2 battlegrounds). Note the asymmetry: front requires CONTROL of battleground SYSTEMS (or 4 Rebels); back is held by OCCUPYING any 2 battlegrounds (sites count too) or by keeping 4 Rebels.
typedIdentities: Filters.Rebel (both directions, count 4; and controlsWith cardFilter)
Filters.battleground (back occupy leg; sites AND systems)
Filters.system + Filters.battleground (once-per-turn download filter pair in DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect(action, Filters.system, Filters.battleground, true))
Back: Filters.and(Filters.snub_fighter, Filters.unique, Filters.piloted); Filters.relatedSiteTo(self, Filters.and(Filters.system, Filters.occupies(playerId))); Filters.liberated_system
setupAndPullRoutes: START OF GAME (front, required): deploy Yavin 4 system: DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect(Filters.Yavin_4_system, true, false) [Card208_026.java:46-52]
START OF GAME (front, required): deploy Massassi War Room: DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect(Filters.Massassi_War_Room, true, false) [Card208_026.java:53-59]
START OF GAME (front, optional): may deploy Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (0..1): DeployCardsFromReserveDeckEffect(Filters.Restore_Freedom_To_The_Galaxy, 0, 1, true, false) [Card208_026.java:60-66]

FRONT, once per turn, cost 1 Force: deploy a battleground system from Reserve Deck: DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect(action, Filters.system, Filters.battleground, true), GameTextActionId.YAVIN_4_BASE_OPERATIONS__DOWNLOAD_BATTLEGROUND_SYSTEM [Card208_026.java:71-93]
BACK: no Reserve Deck pulls (draw-phase action places a Lost Pile card out of play to retrieve 1 Force).
otherObligations: BACK: during battle at sites related to systems owner occupies, total power +2 for each piloted unique snub fighter present at that system: TotalPowerModifier(Filters.and(Filters.battleLocation, Filters.relatedSiteTo(self, Filters.and(Filters.system, Filters.occupies(playerId)))), MultiplyEvaluator(2, PresentAtRelatedSystemToAffectedCardEvaluator(Filters.and(Filters.snub_fighter, Filters.unique, Filters.piloted)))) [Card208_026_BACK.java:51-52]

BACK: once during owner's draw phase, if a 'liberated' system on table (Filters.liberated_system) and Lost Pile non-empty: place a card from Lost Pile out of play to retrieve 1 Force [Card208_026_BACK.java:57-79]
No hard-lose / place-out-of-play condition on either side.
seedMismatches: Seed omits SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE on all legs (both directions).

Seed flipBack comparator 'LESS_THAN_UNLESS_FOUR_REBELS_ON_TABLE' compresses the law correctly but does not state the occupy filter is Filters.battleground (any battleground, sites included) while the FRONT leg is Filters.battleground_system only; the asymmetry (control systems to flip vs occupy any battlegrounds to hold) is a strategic fact absent from the seed.

profileGaps: flipGateSite is null: true flip gate is battleground systems (control 2 with Rebel); objectiveNamedLocations lists 'Battleground system' generically but nothing marks it as the gate.
keyCharacterFilter is null: Filters.Rebel is the flip law's actor (both the 4-count and the controlsWith cardFilter); not represented.
Counts not encoded: 4 Rebels on table; 2 battleground systems; back-hold threshold 2 battlegrounds.
Front-vs-back asymmetry (control battleground_system to flip; occupy any battleground to hold) is not representable/represented.
